feats.title: Accurate Magic Weapon
feats.description: Whenever you use an Artificer power that targets a weapon or an implement, the next attack roll with that weapon or implement before the end of the encounter gains a +1 bonus.

feats.title: Arcane Trapsmith
feats.description: You can use your knowledge of the Arcane during Skill Checks to disable traps or open locks. You gain a +4 feat bonus to checks related to arcane traps or hazards.

feats.title: Crossbow Caster
feats.description: You can use a crossbow as an implement for your Artificer powers and Artificer paragon path powers.

feats.title: Defensive Minions
feats.description: A creature you summon using an Artificer summoning power has a +2 feat bonus to all defenses.

feats.title: Master Mixer
feats.description: You can make alchemical items of your level + 3 or lower. You must have the correct formula and an appropriate skill.

feats.title: Potent Restorables
feats.description: Your Artificer healing powers restore 2 extra hit points. The extra hit points increase to 3 at 6th level, to 4 at 11th level, to 5 at 16th level, to 6 at 21st level, and to 7 at 26th level.

feats.title: Improved Augment Energy
feats.description: The Augment Energy option of your Arcane Empowerment class feature grants a +4 bonus to the attack roll instead of +2.
